name: thunderbird-bridge
description: Search one explicitly selected Thunderbird mailbox using its local index.

interface.longDescription: Read and search one explicitly selected Thunderbird account locally. Retrieved email is passed to the AI host. No telemetry or mailbox writes. Independent Cyp Soft project. Thunderbird is a trademark of the Mozilla Foundation in the U.S. and other countries. No affiliation, endorsement, sponsorship, or trademark permission is claimed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me select one Thunderbird account and search its local mail.
